2609.01604.title: Beyond Scores: Understanding LLM-as-a-Judge Mechanisms in Summarization Evaluation
2609.01604.paper_summary: LLM-based evaluators of natural language generation (NLG) quality are widely deployed as scoring tools and as automated training signals, yet the internal procedure by which they assign a rating remains poorly understood. We investigate this procedure mechanistically through an eight-attack perturbation taxonomy across the Readability and Adequacy dimensions of NLG quality, a generation pipeline that produces paired clean and corrupt summaries with controlled error intensity and explicit token-level modification maps, and a four-experiment battery of causal tracing, logit-lens vocabulary projection, and attention-head knockout applied to Themis (Llama-3-8B) and Prometheus (Mistral-7B). Both evaluators implement a structured, coherent evaluation pipeline operating in two stages: below layer 15, attention performs local error comparison and routes the result to the final input position; above it, the MLP cascade integrates the signal and writes the rating, with the decision crystallizing in the residual stream at a sharp late layer (L = 26 on Themis, L = 25 on Prometheus). Furthermore, a base-model control at the same scale (Llama-3-8B) reproduces the routing architecture and crystallization but not the stage separation, isolating the two mechanisms that fine-tuning specifically installs, suppression of below-L15 MLP contribution at the last position and a two-layer advance of the crystallization depth, indicating that fine-tuning sculpts an existing substrate rather than building the pipeline from scratch. We release the source code and data at https://github.com/himil-v/judge-mech
2609.01604.paper_summary_zh: LLM 基於自然語言生成 (NLG) 質量的評估器被廣泛用作評分工具和自動化訓練信號，但它們分配評分的內部過程仍然不甚了解。<lb/>我們通過一個八攻擊擾動分類法，機械性地調查這一過程，涵蓋 NLG 質量的可讀性和充分性維度，這是一個生成管道，能夠生成配對的清晰和損壞摘要，並控制錯誤強度和明確的標記級別修改圖，還有一組四個實驗，包括因果追踪、logit-lens 詞彙投影和注意力頭剔除，應用於 Themis (Llama-3-8B) 和 Prometheus (Mistral-7B)。<lb/>這兩個評估器實施了一個結構化、一致的評估管道，分為兩個階段：在第 15 層以下，注意力執行局部錯誤比較並將結果路由到最終輸入位置；在其上方，多層感知器 (MLP) 級聯整合信號並寫入評分，決策在一個尖銳的晚層中結晶（Themis 為 L = 26，Prometheus 為 L = 25）。<lb/>此外，同一規模的基礎模型控制 (Llama-3-8B) 重現了路由架構和結晶過程，但不具備階段分離，隔離了微調特別安裝的兩個機制，即在最後位置抑制低於 L15 的 MLP 貢獻和結晶深度的兩層提前，這表明微調是在雕刻現有基材，而不是從頭開始構建管道。<lb/>我們在 https://github.com/himil-v/judge-mech 發布源代碼和數據。
